mapper.select: select client_no as agent_no,name,client_public_key as public_key,status,socket_ip from client where is_agent=1
select * from open_account where cert_no = #{value} limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into open_account(clilent_no, name, account_no, mobile, cert_no, otp_order_no, business_no, client_ip, home_address, lbs, device_id, ele_account_no, agreement_no, open_status, msg, open_order_no, add_time) values(#{clilent_no}, #{name}, #{account_no}, #{mobile}, #{cert_no}, #{otp_order_no}, #{business_no}, #{client_ip}, #{home_address}, #{lbs}, #{device_id}, #{ele_account_no}, #{agreement_no}, #{open_status}, #{msg}, #{open_order_no}, sysdate())

insert into ele_account(clilent_no, name, account_no, mobile, cert_no, ele_account_no, agreement_no, ele_account_status, add_date, add_time) values(#{clilent_no}, #{name}, #{account_no}, #{mobile}, #{cert_no}, #{ele_account_no}, #{agreement_no}, #{ele_account_status}, curdate(), sysdate())
